test_array_attributes: test pybind11 numpy array attributes like ndim, shape, strides, writeable, size, itemsize, nbytes, and owndata
test_index_offset_access: test pybind11 numpy array index and offset access functions index_at, index_at_t, offset_at, and offset_at_t
test_data_mutation: test pybind11 numpy array data access and mutation via data, data_t, mutate_data, mutate_data_t, at_t, and mutate_at_t
test_array_construction_wrapping: test pybind11 numpy array construction, wrapping, and scalar creation with make_c_array, make_f_array, wrap, and constructors
test_overload_resolution: test pybind11 numpy array overload resolution and isinstance type checking with overloaded, isinstance_untyped, and isinstance_typed
